t: Din hannose masseoy ek yinhog battepillin
s: Din hannose masseoy ek yinhog battepillin ubo saip echad: hannose massaoy al rosho — tzarik lachalotz tepillin shel rosh ad sheyyasir hammasaoy. Vaapillu dabar qal, kegon mitpachat — asur lehanniach al harosh sheyyesh bo tepillin, sheggenay hu kesheyyesh al harosh dabar acher sheenah malbush veen darkah lihyot al harosh. Abal dabar sheddarkah lihyot al harosh kegon koba umitznepet — muttar, apillu im munnach al hattepillin. Umikkol maqom, im hu massaoy kabed arbaa qabbin vehattepillin nidchaqot — tzarik lahasiran:
